Ranks Montgomery census tracts by adult diabetes prevalence from CDC PLACES, joining tract names and retaining the adult population denominator, with nulls last and a 200-row cap.
sql:
WITH cdc AS (
  SELECT
    tractfips AS geoid,
    CAST(diabetes_crudeprev AS DOUBLE) AS adult_diabetes_prevalence,
    CAST(totalpop18plus AS DOUBLE) AS totalpop18plus
  FROM session.fw_70a72f_m1_cdc
)
SELECT
  t.name,
  c.adult_diabetes_prevalence,
  c.totalpop18plus,
  t.geoid
FROM fw_pg.tracts t
LEFT JOIN cdc c ON t.geoid = c.geoid
ORDER BY c.adult_diabetes_prevalence DESC NULLS LAST, t.name ASC
LIMIT 200
